channel.title: RoguePod LiteCast
channel.itunes:author: Danny & David
channel.itunes:summary:
RoguePod LiteCast is a podcast about building the most comprehensive roguelite / (non-traditional) roguelike tier list, one game at a time. Every other week Danny or David picks a roguelite to play, discuss, rate, and stack up against the other games they have covered.


Join our discord to give us game suggestions or any other feedback! https://discord.gg/EEwq9VGGKb


View the full tier list at our website! https://roguepod.show


Join the RoguePod LiteCast patreon for monthly bonus episodes! https://www.patreon.com/roguepod

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.
